description.p: Photo Viewer is a GTK and Libadwaita photo application for browsing large local photo collections, opening albums, managing trash, and applying basic edits such as rotation, crop, brightness, contrast, and saturation.

ul.li: Virtualizes the Photos grid and album sidebar, retaining nearby rows and thumbnails to make large-library scrolling and album switching smoother.
Adds configurable day-grid columns, visible-date feedback while scrolling, and fixes placeholder flicker, stale thumbnail requests, and focus preservation during updates.
Improves viewer and album navigation, including full filmstrips when opening from albums, responsive animated-image playback, and more reliable video/image handoff.
Adds Chrome/Perfetto operation tracing and in-app crash diagnostics to make startup, browsing, and album-switch performance measurable.
Adds logical media categories for motion photos, animated images, and HDR images; HDR Motion Photo Containers with gain maps are recognized during indexing.
Uses the current database schema directly; existing databases and saved thumbnail caches must be cleared when upgrading to this development release.

description.p: Prepares the application for a Flathub-oriented 0.9 release with a GitHub-derived application ID, updated metadata, video viewing, motion photo support, album management, theme preferences, and performance improvements for large local libraries.
Fixes virtual scrolling at the end of large photo libraries so the final page loads placeholders and thumbnails correctly.
Adds full browsing, thumbnails, viewer, albums, trash, editing, and Flatpak packaging support.
